purpose: Add a discovery-only online artifact lane for missing ProgramBench replay images and artifacts without trusting online sources by default.
admission_rule: Online can suggest. Provenance can admit. Verifier can trust.
acceptance: missing local image can trigger online discovery
digest-pinned OCI image can be admitted as a candidate
public-untrusted source cannot execute without scan
provenance record is written and signed
Hugging Face artifact requires exact revision
floating main revision is rejected for execution use
old pinned artifact is not replaced in-place
policy: No network pull happens in this lock.
Digest or exact revision is required before use.
Security scan metadata is required for public or upstream sources.
Provenance must be HMAC signed before an artifact can enter replay hydration.
does_not_prove: Does not prove online images are available for Batch 001; the default Batch 001 report keeps online search disabled and returns IMAGE_MISSING for all 10 candidates.
